title: Small steps: Name the adult load
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: I don't have time for this.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: separate adult urgency from the child's worth
principle: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
nextSentence: The task still matters. First, separate adult urgency from the child's worth.
keyLearning: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
